notes: The watch service of the network (plan T18): a user defines persistent observations and conditions over pages, feeds, APIs, events, releases, streams and local devices, and is told when they change or wakes an Actor task, a Codes run, a Run job or a webhook. Sources ingests structured sources, Run runs expensive browser/code checks, Node observes local/LAN things, Events transports the trigger.
